title: Dom Irrera: Live from Las Vegas
overview: Philly native Dom Irrera performs his unique, uncensored comedy special Live from Las Vegas. Dom’s stand-up was honed while growing up in his big Italian family in South Philly. You’ve seen Dom in everything from Seinfeld, Everybody Loves Raymond, as a roaster on The Comedy Central Roast of Bruce Willis to his performance as Tony the limo driver in the Coen Brothers’ cult favorite film The Big Lebowski. Dom is a fan favorite and a frequent guest on The Joe Rogan Experience
